question: The Tableau of which of the following states was given the title of ‘Best Tableau’ on Republic Day, 2023, which was themed as ‘Manaskhand’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Tableau of **Uttarakhand** was given the title of 'Best Tableau' on Republic Day, 2023.
 
• The theme of the Tableau was **'Manaskhand'**.
 
• Uttarakhand's tableau highlighted the cultural and spiritual heritage of the state, showcasing its rich traditions and natural beauty.
 
• The tableau included depictions of important religious and historical sites, as well as scenic landscapes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Republic Day in India is celebrated on **26th January** every year to honor the date on which the Constitution of India came into effect in 1950.
 
• The celebrations include a grand parade showcasing India's cultural diversity, military strength, and achievements.
 
• Tableaux from different states and Union Territories are displayed during the parade, each representing unique cultural and historical aspects of the region.
 
• The best tableaux are awarded based on various criteria including creativity, presentation, and relevance to the theme.
